tok 1.0 "Expense report"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane employee "Employee"
    start received "Expense report received"
    task resubmit "Re-submit the expense report"
    end resubmitted "Report re-submitted"
  lane system "Finance system"
    sub handle "Process the expense report"
      start s "Start"
      xor hasacc "Employee has an account?"
      task create "Create a new account"
      xor m1
      task review "Review the report for automatic approval"
      xor small "Amount under $200?"
      task approve "Approve the report by supervisor"
      xor m2
      xor ok "Approved?"
      task reject "Send the rejection notice by email"
      task pay "Transfer the reimbursement to the direct deposit account"
      end e1 "Report rejected"
      end e2 "Reimbursement paid"
      flow s -> hasacc
      flow hasacc -> create "no"
      flow hasacc -> m1 "yes"
      flow create -> m1
      flow m1 -> review -> small
      flow small -> m2 "yes"
      flow small -> approve "no"
      flow approve -> m2
      flow m2 -> ok
      flow ok -> reject "no"
      flow ok -> pay "yes"
      flow reject -> e1
      flow pay -> e2
    boundary t7 "7 days" on=handle timer=P7D noninterrupting
    boundary t30 "30 days" on=handle timer=P30D
    task progress "Send the approval in progress email"
    task cancel "Send the cancellation notice by email"
    end done "Report processed"
    end inprog "Reminder sent"
    end cancelled "Process stopped"

flow received -> handle -> done
flow t7 -> progress -> inprog
flow t30 -> cancel -> resubmit -> resubmitted
